import os, json, glob
print('ROOT', sorted(os.listdir('.'))[:20])
print('INPUTS', sorted(glob.glob('inputs/*'))[:20])
manifest=None
for p in ['inputs/manifest.json','manifest.json']:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        manifest=json.load(open(p)); break
print('MANIFEST', json.dumps(manifest)[:1200] if manifest else None)
paths=[]
def walk(o):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if isinstance(v,str) and k.lower() in ('path','file_path','local_path','abs_path','file'):
                paths.append(v)
            walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o: walk(v)
if manifest: walk(manifest)
xl=[p for p in paths if p.lower().endswith(('.xlsx','.xlsm'))]
if not xl: xl=glob.glob('inputs/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True)
print('XL', xl[:5])
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(xl[0], data_only=True)
print('SHEETS', wb.sheetnames)
ws=wb['Price history']
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('HDR', rows[0])
data=[r for r in rows[1:] if any(c not in (None,'') for c in r)]
print('NROWS', len(data))
from collections import defaultdict
g=defaultdict(list)
for r in data:
    g[str(r[0]).zfill(6)].append((r[1],r[2],str(r[3]),str(r[4]),r[5]))
for k in sorted(g):
    print(k, g[k])
print('---retail thb covering 2026-11-03---')
for k in sorted(g):
    hits=[t for t in g[k] if t[0]=='RETAIL' and t[1]=='THB' and t[2]<='2026-11-03'<=t[3]]
    print(k, 'hits', len(hits), hits)
print('---retail thb any---')
for k in sorted(g):
    hits=[t for t in g[k] if t[0]=='RETAIL' and t[1]=='THB']
    print(k, len(hits), [(h[2],h[3],h[4]) for h in hits])
wb2=openpyxl.load_workbook(xl[0], data_only=True)
ws2=wb2['Batches']
b=list(ws2.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('BATCH HDR', b[0], 'N', len(b)-1)
from collections import Counter
print('UNIT counts', Counter(r[4] for r in b[1:] if r and r[0] is not None))
ws3=wb2['Pack sizes']
p=list(ws3.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('PACK', [(str(x[0]).zfill(6), x[1]) for x in p[1:] if x[0] is not None])

mm=[r for r in ws4.iter_rows(values_only=True)]
